parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters in the destination region.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the resource group.

parameters.name: GroupUser
parameters.description: The database account to attach. You can attach a standard account or a privileged account.
